entry: Every Octave app native: "I think we should do the clients all natively for all the platforms." Kotlin for Android TV and phones, Swift for Apple's phones and tablets, and a web app; Apple TV deferred. New React Native UI work is paused (octave#388). Octave's product owner plans it; jellyscale asks (ASK-1).
